name: majestic-abilities
description: Portable agent skills organized by capability category, one installable plugin per category.

plugins.name: majestic-cloudflare
plugins.description: Provision, build, and deploy on Cloudflare: OpenTofu infrastructure, Workers development, and Wrangler deployment.

plugins.name: majestic-core
plugins.description: Foundational repository capabilities: making repositories agent-ready and auditing nested repository guidance.

plugins.name: majestic-data
plugins.description: Design, test, and operate data pipelines, contracts, quality controls, dbt projects, and source assessments.

plugins.name: majestic-devops
plugins.description: Provision and operate infrastructure: OpenTofu, Ansible, cloud-init, Kamal deploys, secrets, and infrastructure review.

plugins.name: majestic-engineer
plugins.description: Plan, review, and harden software changes: implementation planning, code and test review, complexity, logging, and multi-agent architecture.

plugins.name: majestic-founder
plugins.description: Founder decisions: company strategy, priorities, bootstrapped finance, go-to-market, fundraising asks, and launch readiness.

plugins.name: majestic-frontend
plugins.description: Design, audit, and validate user interfaces: visual direction, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and screenshot documentation.

plugins.name: majestic-marketing
plugins.description: Positioning, naming, content, campaigns, and growth experiments grounded in verified evidence.

plugins.name: majestic-misc
plugins.description: Portable skills whose long-term domain is undecided: grading skill executions and designing compliant skill structures.

plugins.name: majestic-product
plugins.description: Discovery, requirements, roadmaps, pricing, retention, and product health metrics.

plugins.name: majestic-rails
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug Ruby on Rails applications in DHH and 37signals style, across Hotwire, Active Job, Solid, testing, and review.

plugins.name: majestic-reasoning
plugins.description: Pressure-test plans and conclusions: devil's advocate, premortem, and reasoning verification.

plugins.name: majestic-sales
plugins.description: B2B selling: ICP definition, outbound prospecting, pipeline analysis, enablement, proposals, and account expansion.

plugins.name: majestic-seo
plugins.description: Technical SEO, content strategy, structured data, and Answer Engine Optimization for search engines and LLMs.

plugins.name: majestic-writing
plugins.description: Draft, revise, and audit prose: voice capture, brand voice, copy editing, direct response, and Minto structure.
